proof_audit.topic: Screening threshold and finite value of information
proof_audit.reason: With risk neutrality, zero safe opportunity cost, no other constraints and fixed payoff law, lending has expected surplus H+(F-H)p-L. H<F justifies the threshold division, and the refusal tie is explicit. Conditional independence of the test and repayment outcome given quality is stated before the posterior calculation. Gross signal value is the maximum over contingent funding policies, which contains both constant policies; equivalently each positive part dominates zero and its argument. Total expectation proves the stated inequality, while a null signal requires no conditional posterior. Test cost is paid for every tested applicant and net value is compared with the best untested loan/refusal choice. No no-arbitrage or social-welfare result is inferred.

The borrower receives only its residual project cash and its private benefit. Removing that benefit before action selection changes the chosen success probability; merely observing diversion would not do so. Individual claimants capture only their repayment share and bear their own enforcement cost, so the stated post-funding Nash inequality is valid. Anticipated receipt72 for principal100 is separately recognized as unattractive ex ante. Pooled funding includes principal, enforcement and completion-check costs, with credible conditional payment and verifiable completion assumed explicitly. The six-claimant one-enforcer result, integer N>=8 no-audit threshold, delegation cap3 and private-benefit6 prudence tie all follow from direct best replies.

proof_audit.topic: Double entry, system boundary and dated cash
proof_audit.reason: Loan origination adds equal loans and deposits without changing equity or reserves. External settlement relocates reserves and deposits, so the initial two-bank totals preserve reserves40 and equity26 while deposits rise204 to240. The immediate5 request occurs with zero cash and positive equity18, is reported as unexecuted, and precedes every income flow. Later cash7 cannot meet the earlier deadline. The subsequent ledger is explicitly A-only with external counterparties. A direct uncovered loss reduces loans and equity without cash; an already allowed loss would not be expensed twice. External equity and borrowing provide cash only when actually settled, whereas deposit conversion reclassifies funding without cash.

The one-year period and arithmetic opening/closing denominator choices are explicit. NIM uses net interest over average loans; ROA and ROE use profit over average assets and equity. Gross loan yield minus a funding rate with a different denominator is not NIM. Null output for a nonpositive denominator is preferable to a misleading ratio. Closing insolvency is an allowed model outcome, while unsupported execution requiring negative cash is outside its domain. No regulatory capital standard is asserted.

proof_audit.topic: Private types, feasible insurance and no-run best replies
proof_audit.reason: The separate mutual has a divisible certain long asset, known aggregate early mass, privately learned types, full withdrawal or waiting, storage of date1 receipts, mutual residual sharing and no outside funding or insurance. The population is nonatomic, not100 discrete accounts. Shifted reciprocal utility is increasing and strictly concave, including finite utility at zero. Early-only liquidation pays1.1 and leaves1.45 per late type, so both type-specific deviations are checked. At liquidation return1, direct all-long investment weakly dominates a date0 storage allocation under the stated no-trade alternatives; the utility gain proves a feasible improvement only. At lower liquidation return the manuscript explicitly withdraws the optimal-autarky claim pending portfolio optimization.

Queue positions are type-blind and assigned after requests, so a requester integrates a uniform rank over the served interval. At a full run the served probability10/11 produces utility-5/3, not u(expected cash)=-10/11. An atomless late deviation cannot change aggregate exhaustion and yields utility-10; an early type likewise prefers a positive chance of useful consumption. There is no actual waiter at w=1, so its average payment is null and the hypothetical deviation is separately justified as zero. The result concerns deposits already committed, not initial participation, equilibrium selection, large atomic depositors, known priority, partial withdrawals or insurance.

Liquidation requires wc1/ell units per initial unit until the available asset is exhausted, giving R max(1-wc1/ell,0)/(1-w) for w<1. Capacity ell/c1 and the affine late-resource-surplus root w*=(R-c1)/(c1(R/ell-1)) are well defined under0<ell<c1<R. Positivity and w*<ell/c1 follow without additional restrictions. The quotient derivative is negative before exhaustion; the peer verifies its exact two-point secant identity separately. At lambda4/5 early service is feasible but waiting pays.9, below1.1, so feasibility alone cannot establish equilibrium. Above capacity waiting is zero while the queue offers a positive utility improvement.

exact_prompt_solution_audit.prompt: Correct six managerial claims; propose screening, monitoring and funding validation with limitations; respond to the immediate5 request without inventing a facility.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.independent_solution: Positive expected lending margin does not remove default; reports need a credible payoff-changing response; NIM/equity do not establish cash by a deadline; origination creates a loan and deposit before settlement; a feasible utility gain does not prove optimality; no insurance-cost conclusion is available without modeling its rights and resources. Valid actions address rejected-applicant selection, enforceable and causally effective monitoring, and time-stamped executable funding with delay/correlation limits. Record the unfilled5 request and require actual timely cash from a verified source before treating a remedy as funded. The12-point rubric allocates6 corrected claims,3 actions with limits,2 deadline/remedy points and1 model-versus-evidence point, and its stated critical errors are appropriate.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.verdict: passed; open answer has a coherent exemplar, complete scoring and critical-error rules
